author: Mostovoi, Yu. A. et al.
title: Experimental value of G(A)/G(V) from a measurement of both P-odd correlations in free-neutron decay
arxiv: no arxiv (published in Phys. Atom. Nucl.)
abstract: A new experimental value of the fundamental weak-interaction parameter lambda = G_A/G_V (-1.2686 +/- 0.0046) is obtained for the first time by an original method that consists in measuring both P-odd correlations in free-neutron decay.
